title: m=4 committed-checkpoint fixed-root tangent disentanglement
purpose: Diagnose the retained Phase-41 K_u2 finite-difference plateau at three immutable local roots loaded only from the committed Phase-42 checkpoint, without rerunning a root search, selecting a favorable step or sign, changing Phase 41 from 8/9, or promoting any bounded or global intersection claim.

epistemic_scope.phase41_historical_result_is_immutable: 7/7 exact and 8/9 numerical contracts; P41.tangent.three_full_FD_controls remains TANGENT_CONTROL_FAILED.
epistemic_scope.new_result_scope: At most, an independent prospective derivative audit at shared_zero, phi_plus, and a_plus in one declared m=4 chart, cap radius, launch shape, and fixed mobility.

checkpoint_artifact.storage_format: one raw compact JSON object parsed from the extractor's single CHECKPOINT_JSON record; the prefix is not stored

two_stage_input_freeze.runner_binding_policy: This manifest must be committed before the diagnostic runner is implemented. The runner must embed this manifest's committed path, commit, and SHA-256. No runner path, hash, result, or desired outcome is prefilled here.

three_stage_commit_protocol.stage_1_manifest: Commit this input manifest by itself before runner implementation; that commit and SHA become the runner's immutable input pin.
three_stage_commit_protocol.stage_2_runner: Implement and commit the runner after Stage 1. A production run is forbidden unless the runner is Git-tracked, clean for its path, byte-identical to its latest committed blob, and that commit is an ancestor of HEAD.
three_stage_commit_protocol.stage_2_start_end_guard: At numerical start retain runner path/SHA/latest commit, manifest and checkpoint pins, source closure, HEAD, runtime, and repository pycache snapshot. Immediately before RESULT_JSON recompute all of them and require exact equality; drift emits INVALID_RUN and exit 2.
three_stage_commit_protocol.stage_3_result: Capture, validate, and commit the full raw result artifact with the committed runner before creating or updating any report, ontology evidence, documentation, or later-phase input.
three_stage_commit_protocol.self_provenance_output: The result must retain the runner's observed SHA, latest path commit and blob SHA, clean/tracked/ancestor booleans, start and end HEAD, and every TOCTOU comparison.

two_stage_input_freeze.drift_policy: Any missing file, byte mismatch, commit-blob mismatch, non-ancestor pin, schema mismatch, internal digest mismatch, runtime mismatch, or checkpoint cross-field mismatch is INVALID_RUN with exit 2; no source, checkpoint, root, or environment fallback is allowed.

numpy_blas.openblas_configuration: OpenBLAS 0.3.34.0.0  USE64BITINT DYNAMIC_ARCH NO_AFFINITY Haswell MAX_THREADS=64

numpy_lapack.openblas_configuration: OpenBLAS 0.3.34.0.0  USE64BITINT DYNAMIC_ARCH NO_AFFINITY Haswell MAX_THREADS=64

fingerprint.effective_BLAS_thread_count_scope: The checkpoint pinned the five controlling environment variables as unset but did not retain a runtime threadpool count. Phase 42 must reproduce those null variables and may not claim bitwise determinism from an unmeasured effective thread count.

checkpoint_consumer_protocol.allowed_reconstruction: Rehydrate FixedMetric, SaddleData, Chart, the three immutable parameter vectors, and their authoritative Jacobians directly from decoded checkpoint arrays. Rebuild only NumericModel(delta_a,delta_phi) and the declared residual/flow evaluators from byte-pinned Phase-41 source.
checkpoint_consumer_protocol.no_root_solve_fallback: Checkpoint decode, identity, or map reproduction failure terminates INVALID_RUN; it never triggers Phase-41 replay, a new root solve, hand transcription, looser tolerances, or an alternate checkpoint.

strict_json_decode.signed_zero_complex_decode: For complex payloads allocate the declared complex128 array first and assign its .real and .imag buffers separately from the terminal pairs. Constructing values as real+1j*imag is forbidden because it can erase a signed zero and invalidate the canonical raw-byte identity.

cross_field_identities: each target parameter vector is bit-identical to its all-primary vector and phase41_primary_result.parameters
each authoritative target J is bit-identical to the result variational_scaled_root_jacobian
source point, sphere radius 1e-4, shape lambda 1, and chart-u agree across duplicated records
target launch matrix equals that saddle's lambda-one launch matrix
Gamma state agrees with the recorded primary intersection state
scaled and physical residual identities agree
the completion ledger remains exactly sixteen false, six null, and Gate 1 open

known_before_freeze.role: Disclosed post-result information defines negative controls and reproduction tolerances; it never selects a root, step, sign, cause, or final claim.

fixed_map.center: The immutable checkpoint parameter p_star at each diagnostic point.
fixed_map.root_J_sign_convention: J=row_scales[:,None]*column_stack([V_Gamma,-V_K]); column 13 is the negative row-scaled K flow-time tangent.

three_way_variational_J_protocol.J_checkpoint: The authoritative 14x14 variational_scaled_root_jacobian decoded from the committed checkpoint. It is J_V for all frozen reference and homotopy decisions.
three_way_variational_J_protocol.J_phase41_production_reintegration: Re-evaluate the unchanged pinned Phase-41 augmented DOP853 map once at the immutable p_star, using its original 8e-11 rtol, 8e-13 atol, and 0.025 max_step. No center update follows.
three_way_variational_J_protocol.J_phase42_tight_reintegration: Independently integrate the same complex state-plus-six-chart-tangent equations with DOP853 rtol 2e-12, atol 2e-14, max_step 0.01, then append the analytic Gamma block and negative endpoint flow-time column in the same row scaling.
three_way_variational_J_protocol.independent_J_R4: A separate finite-difference reference assembled from the fourteen preselected tight-state R4_j(0.0002) columns; it is not one of the three transported variational J matrices.
three_way_variational_J_protocol.cause_reference_u2_column: For truncation, chart-curvature, solver-noise, and integrated-variational cause rules, V_u2 means exactly J_phase42_tight_reintegration[:,8]. The homotopy endpoint remains J_checkpoint and is never silently changed.
required_comparisons: J_checkpoint versus J_phase41_production_reintegration max absolute error
J_checkpoint versus J_phase42_tight_reintegration symmetric relative operator error and every-column symmetric relative error
J_phase41_production_reintegration versus J_phase42_tight_reintegration symmetric relative operator error and every-column symmetric relative error
all three root signs, normalized singular spectra, column norms, and condition numbers
J_R4 versus J_checkpoint and J_phase42_tight_reintegration per-column and full-operator metrics
three_way_variational_J_protocol.invalid_drift_boundary: Only the checkpoint versus unchanged original Phase-41 production reproduction of the frozen center state, residual, Gamma/K frames, and J at max absolute 5e-11 is an input/platform gate whose failure causes INVALID_RUN. Tight-integrator comparisons are excluded from this invalidation boundary.
three_way_variational_J_protocol.scientific_comparison_boundary: J_phase42_tight comparisons with J_checkpoint, J_phase41_production, and J_R4 are prospective numerical diagnostics. Their stable failure is valid typed evidence or inconclusive output with exit 0, never source drift and never permission to replace J_checkpoint.
three_way_variational_J_protocol.interpretation: The three matrices are all retained. Disagreement never permits choosing another checkpoint J, retuning a root, or replacing the frozen homotopy endpoint.

finite_difference_protocol.phase41_negative_control_selection: Evaluate every listed step in descending order, retain every failure, and choose the first pair that is both adjacent in the original list and successfully evaluated. A surviving but unfavorable first adjacent pair may not be skipped. In the frozen reproduction all first pairs are expected to survive; assemble the old FD matrix from the first member of each selected pair.

u2_cross_tier_coverage_matrix.P41_production_affine: main ladder, full dyadic tail, and all three exact Phase-41 reproduction steps
u2_cross_tier_coverage_matrix.P42_tight_affine: main ladder, full dyadic tail, and all three exact Phase-41 reproduction steps
u2_cross_tier_coverage_matrix.P42_tight_geodesic: main ladder, full dyadic tail, and all three exact Phase-41 reproduction steps
u2_cross_tier_coverage_matrix.P42_Radau_affine: main ladder and all three exact Phase-41 reproduction steps
u2_cross_tier_coverage_matrix.P42_Radau_geodesic: main ladder and all three exact Phase-41 reproduction steps

finite_difference_protocol.observed_central_order: For each consecutive dyadic triple (h,h/2,h/4), q2=log2(||D2(h)-D2(h/2)||_2/||D2(h/2)-D2(h/4)||_2). q2 is null with a reason when either norm is zero, nonfinite, or unavailable.
finite_difference_protocol.survival_rule: Every declared plus and minus point is attempted and retained. No failed point is skipped, no undeclared h is inserted, and no observed sign, eta, error, or cause may select a replacement reference.
finite_difference_protocol.box_rule: Every p_star plus or minus h*e_j must remain strictly inside the Phase-41 parameter bounds before evaluation. Leaving the box is a typed incomplete slot; clipping is forbidden.

P41_production_state_map.coverage: Use the exact Phase-41 per-column ladders for the old negative control and evaluate the complete affine-chart u2 main ladder plus tail for the production noise curve.

P41_production_augmented_map.representation: complex xi plus 7x6 complex chart tangent
P41_production_augmented_map.coverage: One unperturbed center integration at each fixed point for the three-way J comparison.

P42_tight_state_map.coverage: All fourteen main ladders; the complete affine and geodesic u2 tails; and affine plus geodesic u2 evaluations at all three exact Phase-41 reproduction steps at every point.

P42_tight_augmented_map.representation: complex xi plus 7x6 complex chart tangent
P42_tight_augmented_map.coverage: One unperturbed center integration with states and transported tangents at fractions 0, .25, .5, .75, and 1 at every point.

P42_cross_method_state_map.representation: realified xi in interleaved [Re xi_1,Im xi_1,...,Re xi_7,Im xi_7] order
P42_cross_method_state_map.rhs: Interleave the exact same complex Phase-41 flow_xi value; no flow, action, metric, chart, launch, time, or root change is allowed.
P42_cross_method_state_map.coverage: Affine and geodesic u2 at h=0.0004,0.0002,0.0001,0.00005 and at the exact Phase-41 steps 2e-6,5e-7,1e-7; flow_time at the four main-ladder h values; all at all three points.

integration_tiers.implementation_guard: Phase41.integrate_chart may be used only for the frozen production tiers. It hard-codes production/loose tolerances and must not implement the tight or Radau tiers. Tight and Radau use new tier-specific solve_ivp wrappers around pinned flow_xi and hessian_xi.
integration_tiers.cache_isolation: Cache keys include point, tier, method, rtol, atol, max_step, chart kind, and the complete K parameter tuple. Production, tight, Radau, affine, and geodesic endpoints are never shared.
solver_ledger_per_attempt: xi norm maximum and frozen 40.0 cap
full endpoint xi and z state or typed error

relative_metric_definitions.signed_cosine: cos(x,y)=x^T*y/(||x||_2*||y||_2), with zero norms rejected before evaluation.
relative_metric_definitions.angle_sine: sqrt(max(0,1-cos(x,y)^2)); signed_cosine must additionally be strictly positive.
relative_metric_definitions.solver_derivative_envelope: max(rel(D2_production,D2_tight),rel(D2_tight,D2_Radau)) over the methods declared at that h; unavailable Radau terms are omitted only where coverage explicitly excludes them, never silently.
relative_metric_definitions.adjacent_D2_relative_change: rel(D2(h),D2(h/2)) using the same tier and chart kind.
relative_metric_definitions.old_step_pair_solver_envelope: For each fixed adjacent old-step pair (h_i,h_{i+1}), E_pair=max(E_solver(h_i),E_solver(h_{i+1})) and C_pair=rel(D2_production(h_i),D2_production(h_{i+1})).
relative_metric_definitions.chart_R4_solver_envelope_at_fixed_h: At h=.0002, E_chart=max(rel(R4_affine_production,R4_affine_tight),rel(R4_affine_tight,R4_affine_Radau),rel(R4_geodesic_tight,R4_geodesic_Radau)); all R4 objects use D2 at .0002 and .0001.

algebra_checks: omega^T*d_j_omega=0 for all six chart directions
Phase41 Chart.direction equals the independently assembled formula
the initial launch tangent equals sphere_radius*launch_matrix*d_j_omega
chart_curvature_protocol.independent_arithmetic: Evaluate affine normalization and derivatives in 80-decimal arithmetic after importing binary64 inputs through exact decimal round-trip strings, then compare with the double implementation.

u2_geodesic_control.definition: At fixed u_star, set omega=omega_affine(u_star), v=d_u2 omega, and omega_geo(t)=cos(||v||*t)*omega+sin(||v||*t)*v/||v||.
u2_geodesic_control.evaluation: Use the same saddle, launch matrix, sphere radius, flow time, and both declared tight-DOP853 and Radau state maps over the complete u2 main ladder and all three exact Phase-41 reproduction steps; tight DOP853 additionally covers the full tail. Only finite-step sphere parameterization changes.
u2_geodesic_control.scope_warning: The geodesic is diagnostic only and never replaces the affine production chart, a root, an intersection sign, or a physical cycle.

local_variational_rhs_protocol.transported_directions: All six transported chart tangents at every sampled fraction; u2 is the primary reported direction.
local_variational_rhs_protocol.real_directional_identity: For a real-parameter complex tangent q, D flow_xi(xi)[q]=-conjugate(hessian_xi(xi)*q).
local_variational_rhs_protocol.local_D2_R4_rule: Normalize q, form centered D2(epsilon), form R4(epsilon) from epsilon and epsilon/2, then restore ||q|| before comparison with the analytic Hessian action.
local_variational_rhs_protocol.fixed_local_reference: R4(0.00001), with R4(0.00002) as its sole fixed stability neighbor.
local_variational_rhs_protocol.stable_arithmetic_rule: Both local R4 vectors must be finite and their symmetric relative difference must be at most 1e-6 before a threshold violation is labeled bug evidence.

flow_time_identities.independent_positive_K_tangent: From each independently integrated state-only center endpoint xi_T, evaluate V_K,time_independent=realify(diag(COORDINATE_SCALES)*L*flow_xi(xi_T)) before residual signing or row scaling.
flow_time_identities.original_returned_column_test: Compare -row_scales*V_K,time_independent separately with checkpoint J[:,13] and with the unchanged Phase-41 production augmented integrator's returned root column 13.
flow_time_identities.state_only_R4_test: Compare the preselected tight state-only R4_flow_time(.0002) separately with -row_scales*V_K,time_independent, including both fixed neighbors and Radau main-ladder reference.
flow_time_identities.tight_append_scope: The tight augmented runner may append -row_scales*V_K,time to assemble J_phase42_tight, but equality of that constructed column with the same RHS is only an assembly control and is forbidden as variational-bug evidence.
flow_time_identities.separation_rule: The positive tangent, original returned negative columns, and independent state-only R4 derivative are distinct recorded objects and comparisons.

complex_step_scope.reason: The flow contains conjugation, the residual is realified, the chart uses a Euclidean norm, and adaptive solvers branch on real error estimates.
complex_step_scope.limited_allowed_use: Only a separately declared holomorphic extension of local action-gradient or chart algebra may use complex step; it cannot replace any full-map real directional test.

orientation_homotopy_protocol.variational_endpoint: J_V is exactly J_checkpoint, not an observed best of the three variational integrations.
orientation_homotopy_protocol.reference_endpoint: J_R is assembled from all fourteen fixed tight R4_j(0.0002) columns.
orientation_homotopy_protocol.column_normalization: D_V=diag(||V_j||)>0, D_R=diag(||R_j||)>0, A_V=J_V*D_V^-1, A_R=J_R*D_R^-1. Zero or nonfinite columns fail before normalization.
orientation_homotopy_protocol.sufficient_certificate: eta<1 implies H(t) is nonsingular for every t in [0,1]. Positive endpoint column scalings preserve determinant sign.
orientation_homotopy_protocol.sufficient_only_warning: eta>=1, a small sampled singular value, or failure of the rounding margin does not prove a zero, sign change, singularity, or tangent bug. It means only that this predeclared sufficient certificate is not established. No alternative path, scaling, root, h, or favorable discrete t-grid may replace it.

record: raw and normalized J_V and J_R signs and log absolute determinants
normalized singular spectra and condition numbers
Delta, E, eta, 1-eta, and solve backward residual
sigma_min(A_V), sigma_min(A_R), and the rounding budget

mutation_controls: multiplying columns by fixed positive scales leaves normalized signs and certificate inputs unchanged
flipping exactly one reference column flips its sign and must not pass the eta certificate
the checker never uses sampled t values as a proof
orientation_homotopy_protocol.scope_warning: This is a sufficient local numerical matrix homotopy at three fixed roots, not a determinant-line, upward-manifold, Picard-Lefschetz, or physical-cycle homotopy.

acceptance_thresholds.threshold_policy: All thresholds and denominators are frozen before the diagnostic run. Failure never permits a new step, solver, root, chart, scaling, sign, or threshold.

u2_cause_classification.separation_rule: Completion and cause evidence are independent fields. Completing a diagnostic is not evidence for a cause; a threshold failure caused by missing or unstable data is INCONCLUSIVE, not bug evidence.

TRUNCATION_EVIDENCE.prerequisite: The u2 main-ladder production and tight slots and their solver envelopes are COMPLETE.
TRUNCATION_EVIDENCE.support_if: For each of the two predeclared tight-tier triples with h=.0004 and h=.0002, q2_tight(h) lies in [1.5,2.5] and E_triple(h)<=0.1*C_triple(h); additionally ||D2_tight(.0001)-J_phase42_tight[:,8]||/max(||R4_tight(.0002)-J_phase42_tight[:,8]||,1e-30) is at least 4.
TRUNCATION_EVIDENCE.not_supported_if: Prerequisites are complete and the conjunction is false.
TRUNCATION_EVIDENCE.inconclusive_if: Any prerequisite is incomplete, zero-denominator, or nonfinite.

SOLVER_NOISE_EVIDENCE.prerequisite: Production, tight, and Radau affine D2 values at the exact Phase-41 u2 steps 2e-6,5e-7,1e-7 are COMPLETE, the geodesic tight/Radau reproduction-only attempts are retained, and fixed tight/Radau main references pass.
SOLVER_NOISE_EVIDENCE.support_if: Let e(h)=rel(D2_production(h),D2_tight(h)). Require e(2e-6)<e(5e-7)<e(1e-7), and for each of the two fixed pairs (2e-6,5e-7) and (5e-7,1e-7) require E_pair>=0.5*C_pair using the predeclared definitions above.
SOLVER_NOISE_EVIDENCE.not_supported_if: Prerequisites are complete and the conjunction is false.
SOLVER_NOISE_EVIDENCE.inconclusive_if: Any prerequisite is incomplete or unstable.

CHART_CURVATURE_EVIDENCE.prerequisite: Affine and same-tangent geodesic tight R4_u2(.0002), J_phase42_tight_reintegration[:,8], and the solver envelope are COMPLETE.
CHART_CURVATURE_EVIDENCE.support_if: At the single fixed h=.0002, rel(R_affine_tight,J_phase42_tight[:,8])>=5*rel(R_geodesic_tight,J_phase42_tight[:,8]), rel(R_affine_tight,R_geodesic_tight)>=0.8*rel(R_affine_tight,J_phase42_tight[:,8]), and rel(R_affine_tight,R_geodesic_tight)>=5*E_chart using the predeclared chart R4 envelope.
CHART_CURVATURE_EVIDENCE.not_supported_if: Prerequisites are complete and the conjunction is false.
CHART_CURVATURE_EVIDENCE.inconclusive_if: Any prerequisite is incomplete or unstable.

STEP_PAIR_SELECTION_ARTIFACT.prerequisite: The Phase-41 failed-FD negative control, all fixed Phase-42 u2 references and neighbors, Radau comparison, variational comparison, and homotopy contract are COMPLETE.
STEP_PAIR_SELECTION_ARTIFACT.support_if: The old first pair reproduces plateau failure while every preselected Phase-42 reference, direction, norm, cross-method, and sufficient homotopy criterion passes at that point.
STEP_PAIR_SELECTION_ARTIFACT.not_supported_if: Prerequisites are complete and the conjunction is false.

VARIATIONAL_RHS_BUG_EVIDENCE.declared_slot_count_per_point: Thirty local slots = five flow fractions times six transported chart directions, plus the separately recorded positive K tangent and three negative time-column comparisons.
VARIATIONAL_RHS_BUG_EVIDENCE.support_if: At least one of the thirty local slots has two complete finite R4 estimates passing the 1e-6 neighbor-stability rule and its fixed local R4(.00001) versus analytic Hessian-action error exceeds 1e-7; or at least one complete stable checkpoint/original-production/state-only-R4 time comparison differs from the independently evaluated negative scaled K endpoint tangent by more than 1e-8. The tautologically appended tight column is excluded.
VARIATIONAL_RHS_BUG_EVIDENCE.not_supported_if: All thirty local slots and all declared time controls are complete, finite, stable, and pass their fixed thresholds.
VARIATIONAL_RHS_BUG_EVIDENCE.inconclusive_if: No stable violation is present and at least one of the thirty local slots or declared time controls is incomplete, nonfinite, or fails its reference-stability prerequisite.

PRODUCTION_TANGENT_SOLVER_EVIDENCE.prerequisite: Checkpoint versus original Phase-41 production J passes the 5e-11 invalid-drift gate; local RHS bug evidence is NOT_SUPPORTED; tight J, fixed R4, both neighbors, and cross-method references are COMPLETE and stable.
PRODUCTION_TANGENT_SOLVER_EVIDENCE.support_if: The frozen checkpoint/original-production u2 column differs from J_phase42_tight[:,8] beyond the 0.005 three-way threshold while J_phase42_tight[:,8] passes the frozen vector, positive signed-cosine, norm, and 0.01 comparison thresholds against R4_u2(.0002).
PRODUCTION_TANGENT_SOLVER_EVIDENCE.not_supported_if: Prerequisites are complete and the conjunction is false.
PRODUCTION_TANGENT_SOLVER_EVIDENCE.inconclusive_if: Any reference, tight J, local RHS, or cross-method prerequisite is incomplete or unstable.
PRODUCTION_TANGENT_SOLVER_EVIDENCE.scope: This is evidence that the original transported tangent is solver-accuracy sensitive at the fixed root; it is not platform drift and does not retroactively change Phase 41.

INTEGRATED_VARIATIONAL_BUG_EVIDENCE.prerequisite: Local RHS bug evidence is NOT_SUPPORTED; fixed R4 references, both neighbors, cross method, and three-way J are COMPLETE and stable.
INTEGRATED_VARIATIONAL_BUG_EVIDENCE.support_if: J_phase42_tight_reintegration[:,8] fails the frozen per-column vector, positive signed-cosine, angle-sine, or norm threshold against the stable R4 reference. Eta failure alone is explicitly insufficient for this label.
INTEGRATED_VARIATIONAL_BUG_EVIDENCE.not_supported_if: Prerequisites are complete and the tight transported column passes all frozen comparisons.
INTEGRATED_VARIATIONAL_BUG_EVIDENCE.inconclusive_if: Any prerequisite is incomplete or local RHS evidence is INCONCLUSIVE.

u2_cause_classification.aggregate_rule: For each named cause, aggregate status is SUPPORTED when at least one fixed point is SUPPORTED, NOT_SUPPORTED when all three are NOT_SUPPORTED, and INCONCLUSIVE otherwise. The output must retain all three per-point statuses and must call the aggregate an any-fixed-point summary, not a universal cause.
u2_cause_classification.UNRESOLVED_rule: Per point, UNRESOLVED is SUPPORTED exactly when a required cause prerequisite is incomplete or unstable and no stable cause is SUPPORTED; it is NOT_SUPPORTED when the complete ledger supports at least one cause or stably excludes all declared causes. It is never used to force mutual exclusivity.
u2_cause_classification.multi_label_policy: Cause labels may coexist. They are numerical and procedural evidence labels, not proofs of a unique physical cause.

declared_output_retention.stdout_policy: Exactly one final RESULT_JSON record on stdout; progress and timing go to stderr.

result_artifact.stored_format: one compact sort_keys JSON object followed by exactly one LF; the RESULT_JSON= transport prefix is removed
result_artifact.payload_sha256_without_self_field: The runner computes SHA-256 of json.dumps(payload_without_only_this_digest_field,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False).encode('utf-8') with no LF.
result_artifact.outer_hash_convention: SHA-256 covers the exact committed artifact bytes including the single final LF and excluding the stdout prefix.
result_artifact.null_hash_reason: No result exists at input-freeze time; a result hash is an output and cannot be a desired input.

declared_output_retention.slot_key: point|tier|chart_kind|zero_based_column|h|sign, with separate declared keys for center, augmented, chart, local-RHS, matrix, and mutation controls.
declared_output_retention.preenumeration_rule: Every slot implied by the fixed point, tier, column, step, sign, fraction, and direction products is created before numerical work. Exactly one terminal status is required; duplicate, missing, silently skipped, or undeclared replacement slots invalidate the retention contract.
retain_for_every_endpoint_attempt: full perturbed parameter vector and bounds margins
tier, method, tolerances, chart kind, h, sign, and cache key
nfev, njev, nlu, step count, xi norm maximum
full endpoint xi and z state when available
retain_derived_vectors_and_matrices: F0 for every point and tier
all D2 and R4 vectors, q2, forward/backward asymmetry, and second differences
all three transported J matrices and their pairwise differences
J_R4, A_V, A_R, Delta, E, signs, singular spectra, conditions, eta, margin, and solve residual
all local RHS analytic and finite-difference vectors at every fraction and direction
all cause completion and evidence tri-states with metric paths
all exact and numerical contract records
declared_output_retention.exception_policy: Catch numerical exceptions at the smallest declared slot, retain completed slots, mark dependent slots explicitly, and still emit a finite allow_nan=false typed result. Infrastructure or drift exceptions emit a fail-closed INVALID_RUN skeleton when the manifest can be parsed, then exit 2.
declared_output_retention.nonfinite_policy: Any nonfinite serialized scientific number invalidates that slot and is represented by null plus a typed error; JSON NaN or Infinity tokens are forbidden.
atomic_capture_sequence: Run the committed runner against the committed manifest and checkpoint with pipefail while retaining the runner exit code.
Parse exactly one complete RESULT_JSON record in memory; reject missing, duplicate, truncated, nonfinite, wrong-schema, or trailing scientific stdout records.

Strip only the RESULT_JSON= transport prefix, canonicalize exactly as declared, append one LF, and validate the payload self-digest plus computed outer SHA in a staging location outside the repository.
Move no partial result into the repository. Add the fully validated raw artifact atomically, then commit it with its runner and provenance.
Only after that result-artifact commit may a prose report, ontology evidence, documentation, or later-phase input cite the Phase-42 result.
declared_output_retention.archive_policy: The complete raw RESULT_JSON artifact, not only a report or compact summary, must be captured, hashed, and committed before any later phase consumes Phase-42 evidence.

exact.criterion: The manifest-to-runner-to-result three-stage order holds; the committed runner is tracked, clean, latest-blob-identical, and ancestor-bound; checkpoint, extractor, Phase41/Phase39 closure, locks, commits, SHAs, HEAD, pycache snapshot, and the full runtime fingerprint match exactly at start and before emission.

Strict JSON, outer and self digests, every independently decoded array, exact label sets, duplicate fields, three target cross-identities, and the embedded fail-closed ledger all pass without trusting the checkpoint's own pass booleans.
All three p_star and J_checkpoint arrays are immutable checkpoint inputs; no root, saddle, chart, whitening, branch, clipping, or fallback solver is called before, during, or after the diagnostic.

The R14 residual, row scaling, [Gamma,-K] convention, parameter order, suspect column, exact Phase41 per-column ladders, Phase42 ladders, solver tiers, cache isolation, bounds rule, and no-skipping rule equal this manifest.

D2/R4/five-point formulas, primary and neighbor h values, symmetric denominators, signed cosine, positive column normalization, solve-based eta, robustness budget, sufficient-only interpretation, and mutation controls are fixed exactly as declared.

The affine chart remains the production map, the geodesic has only the same base and first tangent at fixed h, full-map complex step is forbidden, and neither diagnostic may replace a root, chart, map, sign, or intersection claim.

All endpoint, augmented, chart, local-RHS, matrix, classification, and mutation slots are preenumerated exactly once and carry one terminal status; the result schema, prefix removal, self/outer hash conventions, and atomic artifact-before-report capture sequence equal this manifest.
Phase 41 remains 8/9 with its tangent failure; desired outputs remain null; exactly sixteen prerequisites remain false, six global outputs remain null, and Gate 1 remains OPEN_PARTIAL_PROGRESS.

numerical.criterion: Its invalidating PASS predicate is only that, at all three immutable points, the unchanged original Phase-41 production state, residual, frames, and J reproduce the checkpoint within 5e-11. The same record must retain J_phase42_tight and all three signs, spectra, norms, pairwise metrics, and a separate tight scientific completion/evidence substatus; tight failure never changes this drift predicate.

Using the exact old per-column ladders, the old control is faithfully reproduced as TANGENT_CONTROL_FAILED with u2 plateau failure, root sign -1, and all three disclosed operator and plateau metrics within 5e-6 absolute tolerance; PASS never changes Phase 41 to 9/9.
All double and 80-decimal affine chart identities, launch tangents, same-base/same-first-tangent geodesic controls, and the fixed-h curvature ledger are complete at all three points.

All fixed local real-directional R4 identities, the independently evaluated raw positive K endpoint tangent, its comparisons with checkpoint and original-production negative root columns, and the tight state-only R4_flow_time plus neighbors and Radau reference are complete. The tautological tight appended column is assembly-only; stable violations and unstable references receive distinct evidence tri-states.

Every one of 42 fixed primary R4 columns and both fixed neighbors survives, meets reference stability, signed direction, norm, per-column, and full-operator thresholds against the frozen and tight variational J matrices, with no favorable replacement.

All declared production and tight u2 main/tail slots; production, tight-affine, tight-geodesic, Radau-affine, and Radau-geodesic attempts at all three exact old u2 steps; main-ladder Radau u2/time references; solver envelopes; and fixed quantifier metrics are complete at all three points.

At all three points the frozen J_checkpoint and preselected J_R4 have nonzero finite columns, matching nonzero signs, eta<1 with robust positive rounding margin and solve residual, and both mutation controls pass; failure is only noncertification.

Every declared cause at every point and in the any-fixed-point aggregate has separate completion and SUPPORTED/NOT_SUPPORTED/INCONCLUSIVE evidence statuses with cited metric paths, including the exact UNRESOLVED rule and no forced unique cause.

INVALID_RUN_conditions: input, source, commit, hash, schema, checkpoint, array, cross-field, lock, environment, or TOCTOU drift
root, saddle, chart, whitening, branch, or parameter retuning or fallback
column, sign, step, solver tier, tolerance, denominator, quantifier, reference, or retention-schema drift
Phase41 checkpoint-versus-original-production fixed-map/J or exact failed-FD negative-control reproduction drift; tight-J scientific disagreement is explicitly excluded
runner untracked, dirty, not latest-blob-identical, non-ancestor, self/HEAD/source/runtime/pycache TOCTOU drift, or violation of the manifest-to-runner-to-result commit order
missing, duplicate, or internally inconsistent completion/cause tri-state ledger entries
missing or non-null fail-closed global outputs
run_semantics.numerical_failure_policy: A complete non-drift scientific threshold failure is retained as a valid typed negative or inconclusive outcome and does not by itself cause exit 2. Drift-tagged reproduction failures and an incomplete or inconsistent required cause ledger are INVALID_RUN and exit 2.
run_semantics.result_emission: When the manifest is parseable, emit one finite fail-closed RESULT_JSON skeleton even for INVALID_RUN, then exit 2. Progress is never mixed into stdout.

claim_promotion_policy.prospective_local_claim_if_all_required_: At the three immutable Phase-41 m=4 roots only, the preselected fourth-order real finite-difference reference corroborates the transported residual Jacobian and a sufficient nonsingular normalized local matrix homotopy preserves its declared-coordinate root sign.
claim_promotion_policy.inconclusive_if: Any fixed reference, cross-method comparison, three-way J, local variational identity, signed per-column test, or sufficient homotopy certificate is incomplete or fails without stable bug evidence.
